description: Most recent US Department of War (formerly Department of Defense) contract award announcements — Pentagon contracts today, this week, or over any recent window, newest first. Every contract of $7.5M or more is announced here on the business day it is signed, which is weeks ahead of the same award appearing in FPDS/USAspending. Filter by military service/agency (ARMY, NAVY, AIR FORCE, DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY, U.S. TRANSPORTATION COMMAND, DEFENSE ADVANCED RESEARCH PROJECTS AGENCY, DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY, U.S. SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND, and others) and a minimum award amount. Answers "what defense contracts were announced today", "recent DoD/Pentagon contract awards", "who won a defense contract this week".

days.description: How many days back from today to include (default 7).

min_amount.description: Only awards at or above this dollar amount. Note: on rows where shared_award is true, amount is the combined multi-contractor program value, not one contractor's share.

service.description: Restrict to one branch/agency, e.g. "ARMY", "NAVY", "AIR FORCE", "DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY". Matched case-insensitively.

name: dod_awards_recent
